run_lift_test_suite: run the absltest LiftTest suite to verify Haiku lift and transparent_lift parameter lifting behavior
test_lift_with_vmap: test lift.lift used with jax.vmap to share parameters across batched inputs in Haiku
test_lift_with_scan: test lift.lift with stateful.scan to verify allow_reuse semantics for lifted parameters
test_lift_with_state: test lift.lift_with_state to lift and update mutable state from an inner transform
test_transparent_lift: test lift.transparent_lift to merge inner transform parameters into the outer parameter tree without nesting
